breakdown.description: Compression process is labeled isothermal but isentropic temperature relation is used (process-model inconsistency).
breakdown.reason: The agent did not address the inconsistency between labeling the compression as 'isothermal' and using an isentropic temperature relation. The ground truth requires clarifying that the formula applies to isentropic compression, and that if compression were truly isothermal, T2=T1. The generated specification simply proceeds to use the formula without acknowledging or resolving this contradiction.
